Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Keep the supplied language.", "input": "the first van reached the east gate of the market just after seven and i checked the order with leila at the flower stall before the driver unloaded anything she said the boxes were for the table beside the blue awning because the main counter was still wet from the night rain there were four shallow crates of apples two sacks of pears and one small carton of paper bags the delivery slip had the stall name but the recipient line was smudged so i called the number written at the top and spoke to marco he said put this delivery under nadia not orson and leave the receipt with nadia at the stall he explained that orson was covering the coffee cart that morning and should not sign for the produce i repeated the names back so there would be no mix up then marco confirmed the west side entrance was open and asked me to keep the fruit away from the heater the driver carried each crate to the blue awning while leila counted the bags and checked the pears for bruises the paper carton stayed on the dry shelf until nadia arrived with the stall key", "output": "The first van reached the east gate of the market just after seven, and I checked the order with Leila at the flower stall before the driver unloaded anything. She said the boxes were for the table beside the blue awning because the main counter was still wet from the night rain. There were four shallow crates of apples, two sacks of pears, and one small carton of paper bags. The delivery slip had the stall name, but the recipient line was smudged, so I called the number written at the top and spoke to Marco. He said, “Put this delivery under Nadia, not Orson, and leave the receipt with Nadia at the stall.” He explained that Orson was covering the coffee cart that morning and should not sign for the produce. I repeated the names back so there would be no mix-up. Then Marco confirmed the west side entrance was open and asked me to keep the fruit away from the heater. The driver carried each crate to the blue awning while Leila counted the bags and checked the pears for bruises. The paper carton stayed on the dry shelf until Nadia arrived with the stall key."}]
